prompt: A wide shot, taken from a slightly high angle, captures the vibrant atmosphere of a bustling fashion studio. The woman, a woman in her early 20s with loose curly dark brown hair and rich brown skin, stands confidently, wearing a blush pink satin gown that accentuates her curves. Her smooth and softly arched eyebrows are raised slightly, her confident and direct eyes locked onto the camera as she gazes toward it. A composed soft smile plays on her lips, and her lifted jawline gives her an air of determination. Her quarter-turned head and raised chin convey a sense of poise, while her shoulders back and spine long exude self-assurance. One hand rests on her hip, adding a touch of elegance to her overall demeanor. The subject of the fragrance campaign, a prominent celebrity, stands beside her, but their focus is on the camera, not the other woman. The pink and gold palette of the set and the women's outfits adds to the glamorous atmosphere, as the studio lights from the side cast a flattering glow on the scene. No text, no logos, no watermark.
alt: Illustration of a woman in fashion studio, lit by daytime, studio lights.
